settings.title: Product specification
settings.text:
Product Type: Lightsaber-themed chopsticks

Material: Stainless steel (for chopsticks), plastic (for the light-up features)

Dimensions: Typically 9-10 inches in length (varies slightly by model)

Light Features:

Power Source: Batteries (usually included, often replaceable)

On/Off Switch: Located at the bottom of the chopsticks for easy activation

Use: Functional chopsticks for eating, but with the added novelty of lightsaber aesthetics

Design: Replica of iconic lightsaber designs from popular sci-fi franchises (e.g., Star Wars)

Weight: Typically lightweight for ease of use

Cleaning: Hand wash recommended; the LED section should not be submerged in water

Age Group: Generally suitable for ages 12 and up due to small parts or battery components

These chopsticks make for a fun and interactive dining experience, especially for fans of sci-fi and Star Wars!

settings.title: Features
settings.text:
Lightsaber-Inspired Design: The chopsticks are styled to resemble iconic lightsabers, with attention to detail in the hilt and blade design.

LED Light Functionality: The chopsticks light up with LED lights that simulate the glow of a lightsaber when turned on, adding a cool and fun effect while eating.

Multiple Color Options: Typically, the lights come in a variety of colors like red, blue, or sometimes green, mimicking the lightsaber colors from the Star Wars universe.

Easy On/Off Switch: A simple switch at the base of the chopsticks allows for easy activation of the LED light feature.

Battery-Powered: The lights are powered by batteries (usually replaceable), allowing for use without needing to plug them in. Batteries are often included when purchased.

Functional Chopsticks: Despite their novelty, these chopsticks are fully functional, so you can use them to eat just like regular chopsticks.

Durable Build: Made from stainless steel for the chopstick tips, with plastic or other materials for the handle and light-up section, ensuring durability.

Perfect for Themed Events: Great for Star Wars fans, cosplay events, or themed parties, combining practicality with fandom.

Fun and Interactive: Ideal for making mealtime more exciting, especially for kids or anyone into sci-fi and pop culture.

Easy to Clean: The chopsticks are designed for easy cleaning; just hand wash the utensil part (avoid submerging the LED section in water).
